canonical_claim.template: In 2025, Sun West Mortgage Company, Inc denied {value} of its 5,859 decisioned FHA applications.

required_qualifiers.population: Sun West Mortgage Company, Inc decisioned FHA applications (actions 1,2,3; loan_type 2; reverse mortgages excluded)
required_qualifiers.nature: historical institutional aggregate, unadjusted for applicant mix

does_not_establish: Sun West Mortgage Company, Inc will deny any specific future application with 20.2% probability
Sun West Mortgage Company, Inc is stricter or more lenient than another lender for a given applicant
Sun West Mortgage Company, Inc discriminates or violates law
20.2% applies to Sun West Mortgage Company, Inc's non-FHA lending
rule: Free text is the OUTPUT of evidence, not its input. Certify before you write.

proposed_use.proposed_sentence: This lender will likely reject YOUR application
